shape_and_craft.finding: Individual rooted copses distinguish the camp, and supported stone breaks and wear provide readable entrances at the Cut and Keeper. The empty Year Five court has a clear stable silhouette.

materials_and_lighting.finding: Worn slate and dyed cloth are distinct in the site composition. Green muted route beads and live gold signals do not compete; layered Keeper relief avoids a hard cut.

readability_in_play.finding: Approaches and mission pins are not hidden from the reviewed cameras. The updated stick legend and transport state are readable without changing the station.

motion_and_effects.finding: The ordinary title proof distinguishes freely moving cursor, visible marching formation, canceled travel and saved arrival; real year phases remain independently gated.

integration_and_cost.finding: The boundary shelves keep original geometry and save IDs. Shared neutral materials/geometry are pinned separately; no foreign progression, vault branch or added battlefield effects.
